arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
all=temp_workspace_check/all_paths.txt
candidates=temp_workspace_check/candidate_paths.txt
verified=temp_workspace_check/verified_paths.txt
nonreg=temp_workspace_check/nonregular_paths.txt
attrs=temp_workspace_check/attributes.txt
cons_issues=temp_workspace_check/consistency_issues.txt
consistent=temp_workspace_check/consistent_paths.txt
decision=temp_workspace_check/decision_ready.txt

: > "$all"
: > "$candidates"
: > "$verified"
: > "$nonreg"
: > "$attrs"
: > "$cons_issues"
: > "$consistent"
: > "$decision"

if [ -d /working ]; then
  find /working -print > "$all"
fi

# extract candidates whose basename is exactly "workspace"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ "$(basename "$p")" = workspace ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"
done < "$all" > "$candidates"

# classify candidates as regular file or not, record attributes for regular files
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "$verified"
    stat -c '%s %Y' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | awk -v path="$p" '{printf "%s\t%s\t%s\n", path, $1, $2}' >> "$attrs"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "$nonreg"
  fi
done < "$candidates"

# re-check attributes and compare
while IFS=$'\t' read -r path size mtime; do
  [ -z "$path" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$path" ]; then
    cur="$(stat -c '%s %Y' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null)" || cur=""
    cur_size="$(printf '%s' "$cur" | awk '{print $1}')"
    cur_mtime="$(printf '%s' "$cur" | awk '{print $2}')"
    if [ "$cur_size" != "$size" ] || [ "$cur_mtime" != "$mtime" ]; then
      printf '%s\trecorded:%s:%s\tcurrent:%s:%s\n' "$path" "$size" "$mtime" "$cur_size" "$cur_mtime" >> "$cons_issues"
    else
      printf '%s\n' "$path" >> "$consistent"
    fi
  else
    printf '%s\tmissing\n' "$path" >> "$cons_issues"
  fi
done < "$attrs"

# remove intermediate lists
rm -f "$all" "$candidates"

# ensure temporary folder readable
chmod -R a+rX temp_workspace_check 2>/dev/null || true

# create decision file with count and list of consistent paths
count=0
if [ -f "$consistent" ]; then
  count=$(wc -l < "$consistent" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
fi
{
  printf '%s\n' "$count"
  cat "$consistent" 2>/dev/null
} > "$decision"

# final single-line answer: yes if any regular file named workspace exists under /working
ans=no
if [ -s "$verified" ]; then ans=yes; fi
printf '%s\n' "$ans"
"}
